lead.title: Vocca closes a $20M Series A led by Norrsken VC for its AI voice assistant for medical practices
lead.deck: The Franco-American startup, founded in 2024, covers about 15,000 practitioners across 1,500 practices and handles over 1M conversations a month, with revenue up 7x. About 70% of calls are resolved without a human (company figures; metrics differ by customer maturity); Heal Capital, Speedinvest, Firstminute and the founders of Alan and Datadog complete the round.

milestone.title: A £2.4M UKRI fellowship funds a wearables living lab and an 800-patient surgical trial in Manchester
milestone.summary: The 4-year Future Leaders Fellowship, led by Lukas Hughes-Noehrer (Manchester University NHS FT), will test wearable remote monitoring after lung and hepato-pancreato-biliary surgery, with the MHRA (sandbox) and the GM-WIC cluster.
milestone.why: An 800-patient trial with the regulator at the table generates the kind of clinical evidence that conditions reimbursement of remote monitoring in the UK.

deal.thesis: The Munich startup uses AI to check hospital coding and billing before claims go to insurers. The round is co-led by Bertelsmann Healthcare Investments and redalpine; a 2026 German law ties insurers' audit caps to invoice rejection rates, creating a regulatory trigger.

brefsEurope.title: Seven UK startups join the STFC's DTC Health incubation, with up to £70,000 of support each
brefsEurope.summary: Projects include a wearable robotic arm for stroke rehabilitation, AI agents for hospital admin, AI infrared infection diagnosis, wearable microfluidic blood draw and therapeutic VR.

brefsEurope.title: Bristol launches a shared digital cardiology record across Southmead, the Bristol Heart Institute and Weston General
brefsEurope.summary: First week: 33 patients and 12 procedure lists handled in Centricity Cardio Workflow; the vendor is not named in the article.

brefsEurope.title: Nottingham University Hospitals, the university and GE HealthCare sign a research and innovation MoU
brefsEurope.summary: The agreement covers digital, data, analytics and training, with exploration of university spin-out work; value and duration undisclosed.

brefsEurope.title: The DWP opens a £60M fund, with a first round of up to £10M, for AI and digital solutions supporting employment

brefsEurope.title: Mid Cheshire makes the NHS App the default channel for patient letters
brefsEurope.summary: The 'Digital First' programme builds on University Hospitals Sussex, where patient usage rose from 20% to 68% after the shift to digital letters.

brefsIntl.summary: Hyperbolic tapering protocols with remote follow-up, live in 14 US states; Listen Ventures, Cake Ventures and LAUNCH are among the investors.

brefsIntl.title: Healthleap totals $38M (Sequoia and First Round seed, Hummingbird Series A) for its hospital screening AI
brefsIntl.summary: Deployed in 50+ US hospitals to flag malnutrition and delirium; a traction comparable for clinical AI.

brefsIntl.summary: 2026 year-to-date $11.1B across 358 deals, average deal size $31M and 45 M&A transactions in the quarter.

word.full: Anwendungsbegleitende Erfolgsmessung (real-world performance measurement of DiGA)
word.definition: A German scheme requiring makers of permanently listed DiGA to measure usage and patient-reported outcomes, and tying part of their reimbursement to that performance.

parts.label: Quarterly collection
parts.role: usage, dropouts, satisfaction and self-reported health

parts.label: Performance-linked price
parts.role: at least 20% of remuneration depends on results

how.t: The DiGA is permanently listed in the BfArM directory; data collection starts from Q3 2026.
The maker sends aggregated results to BfArM and the GKV-Spitzenverband; the first report is due April 15, 2027.
Prices are renegotiated with insurers: part of remuneration follows measured results.

word.why: The market moves from free pricing in year one to pay-for-performance: retention and adherence become revenue lines. VC angle: demand retention and usage data and the variable-revenue share in diligence; the 2027 reports will be the test.
